findings.title: DocumentDB cluster unencrypted
findings.description: DocumentDB clusters are unencrypted unless storage_encrypted = true; unencrypted clusters expose data at rest.
findings.remediation: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

findings.title: DocumentDB cluster without backup retention
findings.description: With backup_retention_period absent or 0, no automated backups are kept and point-in-time recovery is impossible.
findings.remediation: Enable data protection. Turn on versioning / point-in-time recovery / automated backups with a retention period ≥ 7 days (30+ for production). Test restores regularly — untested backups are not backups.

findings.title: DocumentDB cluster without deletion protection
findings.description: A DocumentDB cluster without deletion protection can be destroyed by a single API call or Terraform change. Enable deletion_protection.
findings.evidence: deletion_protection = absent (provider default: disabled) or false

findings.title: DocumentDB cluster without CloudWatch log exports
findings.description: Hygiene: DocumentDB clusters should export profiler and audit logs to CloudWatch. Set enabled_cloudwatch_logs_exports.
findings.remediation: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

findings.title: DocumentDB cluster without adequate backup retention
findings.description: Hygiene: DocumentDB clusters should retain automated backups for at least 7 days. Set backup_retention_period >= 7.
findings.remediation: Enable data protection. Turn on versioning / point-in-time recovery / automated backups with a retention period ≥ 7 days (30+ for production). Test restores regularly — untested backups are not backups.
